basics.body:
The Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) is the main rulebook for how executive agencies buy supplies and services with appropriated money. It sits in Title 48 of the Code of Federal Regulations, chapter 1, and has 53 parts, each on one topic: Part 6 is competition, Part 15 is contracting by negotiation, Part 43 is modifications.

The FAR says what you must do, what you may do and what you may not do. Where it is silent, the acquisition team may use any sound practice that is in the Government's interest and not prohibited (FAR 1.102(b)(4)).

Every FAR cite works the same way. In FAR 15.404-1(b): 15 is the part, 15.4 the subpart, 15.404 the section, 15.404-1 the subsection, and (b) the paragraph. Clauses in Part 52 carry the number of the part that prescribes them, so 52.243-1 (Changes) is prescribed in Part 43.

- **DFARS** (48 CFR chapter 2) adds DoW rules. Its parts match the FAR plus 200: DFARS 215 goes with FAR 15.
- **DFARS PGI** gives procedures, guidance and information. It explains how; it is not regulation.
- **AFARS** (48 CFR chapter 51) adds Army rules. Its parts match the FAR plus 5100: AFARS 5115 goes with FAR 15.
- Commands may add local policies and instructions on top.

In April 2025, Executive Order 14275 directed the FAR Council to return the FAR to its statutory roots: keep what law requires, cut most of the rest, rewrite it in plain language and renumber where needed.
- **2025:** the FAR Council released model deviation text for every part.
- **1 February 2026:** DoW's RFO class deviations took effect, with matching DFARS changes, so DoW uses the overhauled parts now.
- **23 June 2026:** the first four proposed rules for formal rulemaking (21 parts).
- **18 September 2026:** four more proposed rules (about 16 more parts); comments closed 19 October 2026.
- **Still to come:** the remaining proposed rules, then final rules. Until then, the deviation text is what DoW contracting officers apply.

What it means for you: learn the RFO numbers this guide uses, expect older templates and slides to show old ones, and check the current text before you rely on a cite.

basics.h: Where to find the current text
basics.body:
- The FAR Overhaul pages on acquisition.gov show each overhauled part and the agency deviations.
- DoW's RFO class deviations, with the revised DFARS and PGI text, are listed on the DPCAP class deviations page.
- The Army posts the current AFARS for the workforce; the copy on acquisition.gov can lag.
- The codified FAR on acquisition.gov may still show pre-overhaul numbers for some parts, so compare before you cite.

crosswalk_note: Pairs verified against acquisition.gov's FAR Overhaul pages and DoW class deviations in September 2026 (shared with the Board Ready app) and spot-checked 22 October 2026.

Only one responsible source (and brand name)
Soliciting a single source under simplified procedures
Exceptions to certified cost or pricing data
Certified cost or pricing data threshold
Rule of two (total small business set-aside)
Change orders: duty to keep performing

numbers_note: Dollar thresholds change with the five-year inflation adjustment (the last one took effect 1 October 2025), new laws such as the FY2026 NDAA, and class deviations. These figures were checked 22 October 2026. Contingency figures apply only when the head of the agency has made the required determination.

numbers.name: Micro-purchase threshold
numbers.plain: Buy without competitive quotes when the price is reasonable, usually with the purchase card.

numbers.name: Micro-purchase threshold, contingency, inside the U.S.
numbers.q: Contingency micro-purchase threshold inside the U.S.
numbers.plain: With a contingency or emergency determination.

numbers.name: Micro-purchase threshold, contingency, outside the U.S.
numbers.q: Contingency micro-purchase threshold outside the U.S.
numbers.plain: With a contingency or emergency determination.

numbers.name: Simplified acquisition threshold (SAT)
numbers.plain: At or below it, simplified procedures apply.

numbers.name: SAT, contingency, inside the U.S.
numbers.plain: With a contingency or emergency determination.

numbers.name: SAT, contingency, outside the U.S.
numbers.plain: With a contingency or emergency determination.

numbers.name: Simplified procedures for commercial items
numbers.plain: Request for quotations, then a purchase order ($15 million with a contingency determination).

numbers.name: Presolicitation notice
numbers.q: A presolicitation notice is required above
numbers.plain: Post on SAM.gov unless an exemption applies; 15 days before the solicitation above $25,000.

numbers.name: Public announcement of awards
numbers.plain: Announced by 5 p.m. Eastern on the day of award, under the RFO FAR.

numbers.name: Certified cost or pricing data (FAR)
numbers.q: FAR threshold for certified cost or pricing data
numbers.plain: The governmentwide figure, and DoW's figure for awards on or before 30 June 2026.

numbers.name: Certified cost or pricing data (DoW)
numbers.q: DoW threshold for certified cost or pricing data (awards after 30 June 2026)
numbers.plain: For DoW prime contracts awarded after 30 June 2026, unless an exception applies.

numbers.name: J&A approval: contracting officer (DoW)
numbers.q: DoW J&A approval at the contracting officer level
numbers.plain: The contracting officer approves by certifying the justification.

numbers.name: J&A approval: competition advocate (DoW)
numbers.q: DoW J&A approval by the competition advocate

numbers.name: J&A approval: head of the contracting activity (DoW)
numbers.q: DoW J&A approval by the HCA

numbers.name: J&A approval: senior procurement executive (DoW)
numbers.q: DoW J&A approval by the SPE
numbers.plain: The top approval tier in DoW's Table 206-1.

numbers.name: Small business subcontracting plan
numbers.q: Subcontracting plan threshold for large businesses
numbers.plain: Required from large businesses when subcontracting opportunities exist (after the October 2025 inflation adjustment).

numbers.name: Claim certification
numbers.q: Contractor claims must be certified above
numbers.plain: The contractor certifies good faith, accurate data and amount.

numbers.name: GAO protests of DoW task and delivery orders
numbers.q: DoW task order protest floor at GAO
numbers.plain: Or any order that increases the contract's scope, period or maximum value.

numbers.name: Prompt Payment interest rate
numbers.q: Prompt Payment interest rate for July to December 2026
numbers.plain: Set by Treasury every six months; paid automatically on late payments.

deadlines.name: Protest of a solicitation problem
deadlines.q: Deadline to protest a problem apparent in the solicitation
deadlines.plain: Before bid opening or the closing time for proposals.

deadlines.name: Other GAO protests
deadlines.q: Time to file other GAO protests
deadlines.plain: After the protester knew or should have known the basis.

deadlines.name: Protest after a required debriefing
deadlines.q: Time to protest matters learned in a required debriefing
deadlines.plain: After the debriefing.

deadlines.name: Automatic stay after award
deadlines.q: A GAO protest suspends performance if filed within
deadlines.plain: 10 days after award or 5 days after a required debriefing, whichever is later.

deadlines.name: GAO decision
deadlines.q: GAO must decide a protest within
deadlines.plain: The agency report is due in 30 days.

deadlines.name: Agency protest resolution
deadlines.q: Agency goal to resolve an agency-level protest
deadlines.plain: Best effort to resolve within 35 days of filing.

deadlines.name: Award notice to unsuccessful offerors
deadlines.q: Award notices to unsuccessful offerors go out within
deadlines.plain: After award, to offerors in the competitive range.

deadlines.name: Request a postaward debriefing
deadlines.q: Time for an offeror to request a postaward debriefing
deadlines.plain: After receiving the award notice, in writing.

deadlines.name: Hold the debriefing
deadlines.q: Debrief within this many days of a timely request
deadlines.plain: To the maximum extent practicable.

deadlines.name: Cure notice
deadlines.q: Minimum time a cure notice gives the contractor
deadlines.plain: To fix the failure before a possible default termination.

deadlines.name: Stop-work order
deadlines.q: Maximum length of a stop-work order (unless extended by agreement)
deadlines.plain: Then the order is cancelled or the work is terminated.

deadlines.name: Assert a right to adjustment (Changes clause)
deadlines.q: Time for a contractor to assert its right to an adjustment under 52.243-1
deadlines.plain: From receiving the written change order.

deadlines.name: Submit a claim
deadlines.q: Time limit for a contractor to submit a claim
deadlines.plain: After the claim accrues.

deadlines.name: Contracting officer's decision on a claim
deadlines.q: Time for a final decision on a claim (or to set a date for larger claims)
deadlines.plain: For claims over $100,000, decide or set a decision date within 60 days.

deadlines.name: Appeal to the board (ASBCA)
deadlines.q: Time to appeal a final decision to the ASBCA
deadlines.plain: From receiving the final decision.

deadlines.name: Appeal to the Court of Federal Claims
deadlines.q: Time to take a final decision to the Court of Federal Claims
deadlines.plain: From receiving the final decision.

deadlines.name: Prompt payment
deadlines.q: Standard payment due date under the Prompt Payment Act
deadlines.plain: After a proper invoice or acceptance, whichever is later.

deadlines.name: Closeout: firm-fixed-price
deadlines.q: Close out an FFP contract within
deadlines.plain: After evidence of physical completion.

deadlines.name: Closeout: indirect rates required
deadlines.q: Close out a contract needing indirect rate settlement within
deadlines.plain: Of the month physical completion evidence arrives.

deadlines.name: Closeout: all other contracts
deadlines.q: Close out all other contracts within
deadlines.plain: Of the month physical completion evidence arrives.

deadlines.name: Certification grace period
deadlines.q: Time to earn the DoW Contracting Professional certification
deadlines.plain: From entering a contracting-coded position.

deadlines.name: Continuous learning
deadlines.q: Continuous learning required after certification
deadlines.plain: DPCAP recommends at least 40 hours on contracting topics.

deadlines.name: Exam retakes
deadlines.q: Rules for retaking CON 3990V
deadlines.plain: At least 30 days between attempts; up to three attempts in 12 months.

deadlines.name: Exam scheduling window
deadlines.q: Time to take CON 3990V after the Authorization to Test
deadlines.plain: From when Pearson receives your authorization from WarU.
